description: This PHP file defines the Basic class, which extends SugarBean and provides methods for handling email addresses and generating summaries within a CRM module. It includes properties, constructor, and methods related to email address retrieval, validation, and string manipulation.

classes.name: Basic
classes.description: A class representing a basic CRM entity with email handling capabilities, extending SugarBean and including methods for email address retrieval and summary text generation.

methods.description: Returns a string summary of the object, typically using the name property.

methods.description: Retrieves an EmailAddress object based on the provided email field, validating the field and using other internal methods.
